AI Customer Support

Fin by Intercom

Fin is Intercom's AI customer-service agent for resolving support conversations across service channels and handing unresolved work to human teams.

What is Fin by Intercom?

Fin is an AI support agent built into Intercom and also offered for use alongside selected existing help-desk environments. It answers customer questions from company knowledge, can execute supported procedures and escalate when needed, while Intercom charges primarily around successful AI outcomes rather than only seats.

Best for: Support organizations that want an AI agent to resolve repetitive customer conversations while preserving escalation to human agents.

Main features

  • AI customer-question resolution
  • Knowledge-grounded responses
  • Procedure and workflow execution
  • Human-agent handoff
  • Multi-channel support workflows
  • Outcome reporting and optimization
  • Fin Agent API

Use cases

  • Resolve common support questions automatically
  • Handle repetitive troubleshooting flows
  • Collect information before human escalation
  • Deflect routine ticket volume
  • Deploy AI support alongside an existing help desk

Who is it for?

  • customer support teams
  • SaaS companies
  • support operations leaders
  • help-desk teams
  • digital customer-service organizations

Pricing and plans

usage-based per outcome, with optional Intercom seat subscriptions

Starting price: USD 0.99 / per standard Fin outcome

Check official pricing ↗

Advantages

  • Outcome-based billing aligns cost with completed AI work
  • Can operate inside Intercom or with supported external help-desk setups
  • Official Fin Agent API is available for programmatic use

Limitations

  • Total cost can combine Intercom seat fees with Fin outcome charges
  • Standalone Fin deployments can involve minimum outcome commitments
  • Some outcome types, channels and advanced capabilities have different or separately quoted pricing

Review method

Frequently asked questions

How is Fin priced?

Intercom lists Fin from $0.99 per standard outcome. Certain outcome types can carry different prices, and using Fin with an Intercom service plan can also involve seat charges.

Does Intercom provide a free trial for Fin?

Intercom's pricing material documents a 14-day trial for its service platform, with Fin and selected add-ons included according to the chosen setup.

Can Fin be called programmatically?

Yes. Intercom publishes a Fin Agent API for integrating Fin into custom customer-service experiences.
